content.title: GAN Set for Merger with SEGA SAMMY Subsidiary, Plans Delisting
content.summary: GAN ( (GAN) ) has provided an update. GAN Limited, a leading technology provider for real money internet gaming, has announced that the Nevada Gaming Commission approved its merger with a subsidiary of SEGA SAMMY CREATION INC. The merger is anticipated to be completed between late 2024 and early 2025, subject to additional regulatory approvals.
